about.title: // about_me
paragraphs: I build web and mobile products that ship and stay in production.

Fullstack Developer with 6+ years across the full delivery cycle: cross-platform mobile apps with React Native & Expo, modern web with React & Next.js, and backend APIs with Node.js & NestJS, all in TypeScript, backed by PostgreSQL and deployed on AWS.
What I've been working on lately:
• Leading multiple products as Tech Lead at Bolt: React Native apps and NestJS APIs in production, PostgreSQL data modeling, and clearing performance bottlenecks.
• At ioet: hardening authorization and RBAC on a high-traffic app (Warby Parker), and leading an end-to-end UI renovation in React/Next.js (Cynch.ai).
• Automating cloud deployments on AWS with Terraform, Ansible, and GitHub Actions.
I care about clean code, solid architecture, and agile teamwork, and I use AI tooling (Claude Code) to ship faster without trading away quality.
Beyond the code, I'm the Founder & Lead of Google Developer Group (GDG) Quito, where I organize technical talks and mentor junior engineers.

bullets: Lead development across multiple products as Tech Lead, taking them from concept to production, including ZapX, a mobile app for finding photographers in your area, and a news platform.
Own end-to-end architecture and delivery across products, from Nest.js APIs to React Native / Expo apps on PostgreSQL and AWS.
Set code-quality and architecture standards across teams and resolve performance bottlenecks, using AI tooling (Claude Code) to accelerate delivery.

Engineered a high-performance streaming platform with Vue on the frontend and Express on the backend, supporting concurrent broadcasting to YouTube, Twitch, Facebook, and custom RTMP endpoints via Nginx.

Built a scalable, asynchronous notification system with AMQP, and integrated video editing and clipping tools that let creators repurpose content for cross-platform delivery, with media metadata and user data on PostgreSQL.
Warby Parker: Hardened application-wide access control by identifying and patching permission-level security vulnerabilities across the project lifecycle.
Cynch.ai: Cut manual classification effort for US accounting teams by leading a UI/UX overhaul and delivering an end-to-end document-linking workflow.
Shaped architecture decisions and code quality across agile, distributed teams.
Delivered four concurrent internal systems: staffing tracking, payroll processing, and performance evaluation, while upskilling into DevOps.
Simplified Cloudbrink's VPN client onboarding with Golang tooling that removed a complex manual configuration and automated AWS deployments with Terraform and Ansible.

Delivered the full UI of a cross-platform delivery app serving Venezuelan immigrants and newly arrived refugees, a population with limited access to digital services, built with Flutter/Dart and Firebase (auth + real-time data), driving social impact at scale.

Supported patient care during the COVID-19 pandemic by contributing to a Hospital Management System: implemented patient registration and appointment scheduling in C#, and built the patient portal with Blazor Pages, improving usability for clinical staff and patients under high-pressure conditions.

items.title: > Salva_o_Condena/
items.description: Resource-management game built for a game jam this year. You play an alchemist rationing a finite stock of potions across four villagers who never heal on their own — every week forces a choice between two losses. Built with Phaser 4 and React, with a seeded RNG driving emergent accidents, catastrophes, and permanent conditions.
